title: Chink Martin, Sharky and his road experience
summary: Gossip on Chink Martin and Sharky Bonano, and his claim of 12-15 years on the road.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong

blocks.x: Oh. You know that kind of business? Yeah, that's just so much talk. I've heard it too. Wow. They call, uh, they call the man all kind of dirty names and everything else. They wouldn't play with him, uh, like Chink Martin. He said he wouldn't play with Sharky again if he was the last man in the world.
Well, what happened between them? Well, I don't know.

But when I saw Chink Martin on Royal Street and he was working with Sharky, I said, what happened? The world's coming to an end, Sharky, but you told me that you wouldn't, uh, work with Sharky if he was the last man in the world. I said, you must be all by yourself. He walked away. He didn't ask me or anything. He just walked away. And I, I think he's sore at me ever since. He's not with Sharky on this trip, is he?
You know who Sharky's got with him? I don't know.
Well, I don't know who else. Somebody told me. I, I don't know. I didn't even see him. Somebody.
I just found out last week that he was gone because I've got his sister-in-law, Mrs. Ziegler, and Mercy, who, between life and death, a heart attack.
Uh, I didn't know he was gone either.
Tell me he won't be back until after the next year because he's, he's got contracts. He's not. He's not.
No, he's going to Canada. Oh.
Yeah. Well, he's all right. He's all right as far as the word goes. But he's another crazy guy. I don't understand that.
That boy's a fine trumpet player. I don't understand.

Doc, he don't know when he's well off. That's his trouble. That's right. He won't, uh, he thinks what he don't know, nobody else knows. But as far as travel and experience on the road, not only with bands, with shows, with, with almost every kind of entertainment, I could, uh, give them cards and spades and beat them because I, I, all in total, I spent about 12, 15 years just on the road alone. So I know it done good and well, yes.
